audience: finance and operations teams who extract data from invoices, receipts and documents with Doxis AI.dp (Klippa DocHorizon)

useCases.title: Pull supplier, date and totals from an invoice or receipt
useCases.text: The AI sends an invoice or receipt and returns merchant, customer, dates, totals, VAT, line items and currency as structured data.

useCases.title: Read a bank statement or payslip into data
useCases.text: The AI extracts a bank statement (balances and every transaction) or a salary slip (gross, net, deductions). The result holds personal data, so handle it with care.

useCases.title: Check which fields a capture model returns
useCases.text: The AI lists the enabled capture models and configurations, and reads the JSON schema of a model. You can see if a field, such as the VAT number, is returned.

useCases.title: Validate an e-invoice or convert it to JSON
useCases.text: The AI checks an e-invoice XML or hybrid PDF against its standard, such as EN 16931 or XRechnung, and lists each broken rule. It can also convert it to Universal Invoice JSON.

useCases.title: Look up a company in the Peppol directory
useCases.text: The AI searches the public Peppol directory by name or identifier, and looks up one participant to see which document types it can receive.

useCases.title: Queue a document, check its job or delete it
useCases.text: The AI submits a document for asynchronous capture, checks the job status and reads the result. It can delete the job with its stored documents.
